passive.descEnRank1: Grants 12% All-Attribute DMG Bonus. After the wielder inflicts Electro Flare or triggers Unison Response, Resonance Skill DMG is Amplified by 36% and ignores 10% of the target's Electro RES. While the wielder is the active Resonator, Electro Flare DMG taken by targets within a certain range is Amplified by 30% for 30s, triggered 1 {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=6} every 0.1s. Only the strongest effect of the same name applies.
